steps.text: 9:00 A.M. / Overcast
14 hours before the attack on L. G. D. Headquarters
'Bad Guy' - 300 Meters above 'District 14' of Chernobog
Mission objective: Join forces with Rhodes Island to rescue the reconnaissance team
Assigned assets:
'Bad Guy' and its pilot; Rhodes Island elite operator Blaze and her team.
14 individuals.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: This is your stop. Amiya and her people are nearby!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Was it really okay to drop the team outside the city? You're gonna go down there by yourself?!
Come on, it's a lot better for them to be out there clearing a path and pushing back Reunion's pursuit forces than to fight here.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Okay. The terrain down there is pretty rough. This is as far as I can take you.
It's fine.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: ...At least let me put down a rope for you?
When have you ever seen me use a rope?

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: You're just gonna go for it again, huh?
Go for what? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Every time we have a mission together, you go off and do crazy stuff while I sit in the cockpit on pins and needles and watch.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: I'm kind of used to it, but that doesn't change the fact that you're way too reckless out there.
That just goes to show you what a good rapport you, me, and my team have!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Rapport my ass! Last time you demolished a town, bombed out a reservoir, and collapsed a mine!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Keep the chaos on the ground please, don't bring it onto my baby!
Fine, fine. I got it. But, 'Bad Guy,' really? Maybe think a little harder next time you pick a name.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Just jump already.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: I think the welcoming committee's spotted us. This is where we say goodbye, Blaze.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No problem.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: I'll wait for you by the entrance to the ruins. Be quick!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Huh? The comms.
HELLO?!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: I can hear you! You don't have to yell!
Oh. Hi, Rhodes Islanders. I'm with the L. G. D. I've met up with your team by the ruins!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Didn't the L. G. D. withdraw already? What are you trying to pull?
I'm not like that Ch'en lady! Trust me, I can help you.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: And how should we call you?
Use my codename. Call me Officer Swire!

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Isn't Swire just your name?

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Blaze, can you take care of this? I'm not good with bureaucrats...

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: ......Blaze?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Don't look at me.

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Get back here! Don't jump!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Didn't you tell me to jump a second ago? You can handle this. I believe in you! *Mwah*

steps.name: Pilot
steps.text: Mwah my ass!

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: *Pant* *pant*...

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: ...Is she okay?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, it's nothing serious. Just her body temperature's a little low.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: It's always... low. I'm fine. I just...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Frostleaf, slow down. Your temperature is even lower than usual.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, pass me a bandage.

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: I told you, I'm fine. Meteorite got hit a lot harder.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: It's okay. I'm a Sarkaz. I'm more worried about you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Jessica, what is Yeti Squad doing?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Th- they're approaching our position! About 500 meters out!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And the debris clearing?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We need about fifteen more minutes. The collapsed building has a pretty complicated superstructure and we can't risk blasting here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Meteorite, get ready to fight. We have to hold this line.

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: Roger. Do we have a stock of bolts?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes. Logistics can get them for you...
Amiya, are you there?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...guh.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did somebody leave their comms open?
This is the elite operators' channel, I can open it from my end.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That voice...?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: Oh no. They sent her.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Um... who is it?

options: Yes, who is this? And what's got her so excited?
Can she really make a difference here?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: They call her Blaze. She can certainly level the whole area and leave everyone pissing themselves.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Damn right it's me! But that last part is a little off.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please... let's be serious here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Where are you, Blaze? We need your support.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm right above you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Just about 200 meters to go and I'll be there!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: I can't hit the machine, it's out of range!

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: Flying machines... they have such equipment?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Make sure they do not come down.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Wipe out the Rhodes Island squad before their reinforcements arrive. They cannot be allowed to join forces.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ———Stand back!

steps.name: Meteorite
steps.text: She jumped again?

steps.name: Frostleaf
steps.text: She jumped again.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: We can jump together sometime, Amiya! If you want.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think I'll take a rain check. Where's your team?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I left them outside the city. They'll be here in a bit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't hear anything over the wind. Turn off your comms!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone... move to support Blaze.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, no matter what she says...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...just nod.

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: It dropped something...

steps.name: Yeti Squad Member
steps.text: ...a person?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: There's only one. But keep your guard up.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I sense a heat. She's using some kind of temperature Arts.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hello, Reunion friends.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I don't like fighting other Infected. But I heard you hurt some of my Rhodes Island co-workers...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: And you're still after my buddies. So I'm going to have to put a stop to that.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Aren't you mouthy...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hi. How you doing, Miss Frosty?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I wanna see what happens when my hot meets your cold.
